tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ mchod sbyin bsil gtor gaṅgā'i chu rgyun bzhugs so//

swa sti pra dzā bhyaḥ phun tshogs dge legs bye bas rab bskrun zhing*// rnam mang nyes brgya'i bag chags gzeb grol bas// ma lus 'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing gyur pa// bla ma mchog dang thub dbang sras bcas rgyal// nges 'byung lhag bsam bgrod pas bskul ba las// sngon med legs bshad zla ba gsar pa'i 'dzum// skal bzang shar ri'i rtser son 'od snang zer// phan bde'i kunda bzhad pa'i dpyid du gsal// de yang rten gyi gang zag 'khor ba'i rang bzhin sdug bsngal du shes pas yid nges par byung zhing*/ thar pa'i phan yon mthong bas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob 'dod kyi bsam pa drag po dang ldan pas thabs 'di la nan tan du bya ba yin te/ gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su mchod gtor chu snod sogs mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par bshams nas bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi sgom pa rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'phags pa thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar gsal zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon padma dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can mtshan dpe'i gzi byin mchog tu 'bar ba'i skur gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi dzwa la hri da ya garbhe dzwa la du ru du ru ni swā hā/ zhes bdun bzlas pas dge ba brgya 'gyur du 'phel bar 'gyur ro// sa gzhi byin brlab ni/ khor yug gi sa gzhi 'di dag bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa lta bu phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pas mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ sarba bitpāt+s+mu ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya ho spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ mchod rdzas byin brlab ni/ phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing de dag tu lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa gzugs dang*/

sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ reg bya la sogs pa rnam par dag cing yid du 'ong ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba tha khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs te/ spyan drangs pa ni/ 'dun pa rtse gcig pas 'di skad do/ phyogs dus kun nas skyabs gsum bka' sdod bcas// nyon mongs 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas// dpag med zhing nas thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis// 'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs gsol// bla ma mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sprin// yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can sgyu 'phrul gar// skye mang drin gyis brtse ba'i ris med 'gro// ma rig 'dzin pas rtag 'khyams sha 'khon tshogs// kun kyang bde chen chos sku'i rol pa las// 'gag med sgyu ma'i rnam par shar ba'i mgron// thams cad gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin la// mos dungs brtse bas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ gyis gdan phul la/ dri med yid 'ong lha rdzas las byung ba'i// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos dang*// mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo sogs// kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ nas shapda'i bar gyis mchod la/ khrus chab sbreng zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes sku khrus gsol te/ de las gzhan yang sogs kyis rgyas par mchod do// de nas chu sbyin dang po ni/ rang nyid thugs rje chen po'i phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi rtse las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas yi dwags rnams tshim par bsam zhing*/

oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ zhes gang bar blug /gnyis par/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ gsum par/ dzwa la mi daṃ sarba pre te bhyaḥswā hā/ zhes thigs pa sbreng zhing se gol gtog /bzhi par/ oṃ dzñā na a ba lo ki te sa manta rasmi bha ba ma hā ma ni du ru du ru hri da ya dzwa la ni swā hā/ zhes dang*/ lnga par/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ trā sa ni trā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karmā pa raṃ pa rā ṇi me sarba satwa nañtsa swā hā/ zhes gang bar sbreng zhing*/ bar do'i 'gro ba rnams gtsang zhing bsil ba'i skom gyis tshim ste bla na med pa'i bde ba mchog la reg par gyur cig /ces dang*/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// 'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang*// sems can rnams la phan gdags slad// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// thogs pa med par 'grub gyur cig /ces bden pa'i stobs brjod de smon lam gdab bo// de nas dzambha lha la chu sbyin dbul ba'i don du mchod gtor bshams la/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du dzaṃ yig ser nag yongs su gyur pa las rim pa bzhin dzambha la ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ bi dza pū ra ka dang gter gyi ne'u le bsnams pa/ utpal dang rin po che'i rgyan phreng du mas spras pa/ brjid pa'i nyams can pad zla'i gdan la rol zhing dung dang pad chen gter bdag mnan pa'o// dzambha la nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ thod khrag dang gter gyi ne'u le bsnams pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan cing*/ gcer bu khros pa'i nyams can pad nyi'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gis nor bdag ser po mnan pa'o// gnyis ka'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ slar yang dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs pa de rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil pa las rin 'byung dang mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ rang gi lag mthil g.yas par zla ba'i steng du bhrāt+s+muṃ āṃ dziṃ khāṃ hūm̐ las de bzhin gshegs pa lnga ye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu ste sor mo las babs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ dzambha la dza lend+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pas chu gtsang sbreng zhing*/ dbu'i rma'i zug rngu zhi ste dgyes par bsam mo// de bzhin du dzam nag la/ oṃ ind+ra ni mu khaṃ bhra ma ri swā hā/ zhes brjod la/ oṃ dzaṃlu swā hā/ zhes pas sngar ltar 'bul la/ mgrin pa'i rma'i zug rngu zhi ste dgyes par bsam/ gtor ma gnyis/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥs bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du bltas la/ sngags tshan gnyis kyi mthar sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ grihṇantu ma ma sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ zhes lan gsum gyis rim par dbul/ oṃ ārya dzambha la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shapda'i bar gyis mchod/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*// gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje// byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzambha la// dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// rdul bral nam mkha'i mdog can gtum brjid gzugs// sgeg sogs nyams dgus rnam rol gter gyi bdag /dbul ba'i gdung sel 'dod rgu'i mchog stsol ba'i// mgon po nor sbyin khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ ser sna'i las kyi me yis gdungs pa rnams// skye dang skye bar khyod la skyabs su mchi// rin chen bdud rtsi'i gter gyi char chen pos// sems can dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod/ ces gsol zhing chu thigs re lcer bzhag la/ oṃ dzambha la siddhi pha la hoḥ zhes dngos grub blang*/ rten yod na de la bstim/

med na/ badzra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ dzam dmar sogs kyi chu sbyin byed na'ang 'dir sbrel lo// de nas dkar gtor cha lnga'am bzhi bshams la/ dang po gnyis/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrāt+s+muṃ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bltas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis sbar ba'i dang po mi g.yo ba la 'bul te/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rje btsun mi g.yo ba sku mdog sngon po ral gri dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ sbrul dang rin po che'i rgyan can pad nyi la bzhugs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi rgyas/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdun gyi mthar/ ārya a tsa la sa pa ri wā ra i dam ba liṃ ta sogs gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ ārya sogs kyis mthar arghaṃ nas shapda'i bar gyis mchod/ gtum chen khro bo mi sdug gzugs// mthing nag ral gri zhags pa 'dzin// drag po'i stobs kyis gar mdzad pa// mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ zhes bstod/ bdag dang sems can thams cad bdud bzhi'i bar chad las skyob cing mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ gnyis pa rje btsun ma la 'bul te/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rje btsun sgrol ma sku mdog margad lta bu/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon utpa la 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can pad zla la bzhugs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi rgyas/ na maḥsarba buddha bo dhi satwa naṃ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā nāṃ/ he he bha ga ba te ma hā satwa buddha a wa lo ki te/ ma bi lamba mā bi lamba/ i daṃ ba liṃ grihṇa ba la hūm̐ hūm̐/ sarba bi sañtsa ra swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul la/ oṃ arya tā re sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shapda'i bar gyis mchod/

lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhabs kyi padmo la btud de// phongs pa kun la sgrol mdzad ma// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ bdag dang sems can thams cad 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug sogs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag las skyob cing mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ gsum pa klu rnams la 'bul te/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi rgyas/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐/ zhes bsang*/ rdo rje me'i rgyas/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa kyis sbyangs te/ rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma klu rnams dga' bar byed pa'i 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la/ rdo rje bsdams pa 'degs tshul gyis/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ādya nutpanna totta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis spel la/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcings te/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas klu'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam la/ oṃ ba ta li ba ta li ma hā ba ta li hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswā hā/ oṃ/ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu// 'jog po dngani stobs kyi rgyu// padma padma chen po dang*// dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan no// lha mo lha mo chen po dang*// zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che// dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang*// sog ma med dang hu luṇḍa// dga' bo dang ni nye dga' bo// rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang*// tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang*// dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che// rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang*// gzugs mdzes chen po sprul bzang dang*// lto 'phye chen po tshi li dang*// tshi li chen po rnam dag ni// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ ā gatstsha ā gatstsha ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye sarba bhurbhu waḥphruṃ phu swā hā/

zhes mdun du byon par bsam la/ padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ gyis gdan 'bul/ oṃ ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye gṛhṇe daṃ arghaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ puṣpaṃ/ dhu paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gandhaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ klu dga' bar byed pa'i rgyas/ i hi li hi li ma hā hi li phruṃ phu swā hā/ zhes se gol dang bcas pas lan gsum dang*/ oṃ bhakṣa ya bhakṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣṭha phruṃ phu swā hā/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma bsngo/ ye dharmā dang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ zhes chos kyi sbyin pa bya/ klu chen po brgyad sogs klu'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang bye brag bdag cag la gnod cing lan chags pa thams cad mnyes shing tshim nas gnod 'tshe dang gdug sems zhi ste phan pa byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig /ces smon lam gdab/ oṃ ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye sa pa ri wā ra gatstsha/ zhes dkar phyogs kyi klu rang gnas su gshegs/ mkha' lding gi rgyas/ oṃ ga ru ḍa haṃ sa he tsa le tsa le swā hā/ zhes nag po'i klu rnams bskrad par bya'o// skabs gzhan du klu gtor byed na'ang 'di nyid do// bzhi pa su ru pa'i sngags kyis yi dwags rnams la sbyin pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis rin chen gzugs mdzes su gyur par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis/ yi dwags rnams tshim par nus pa'i 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du bltas la/ na maḥsu ru pā ya ta thā ga tā ya arha te samyaksaṃ buddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ su ru su ru/ pra su ru pra su ru/ ta ra ta ra/ bha ra bha ra/ sambha ra sambha ra/ sma ra sma ra/ santarba ya santarba ya/ sarba pre tā nāṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis mthar se gol gtogs shing*/ a pa sa rantu a wa tā re pre kṣi ṇo da dā mya haṃ sarba lo ka dhā tu bha si nāṃ pre tā nā ma ha raṃ/ zhes lan gcig brjod cing chos kyi sbyin pa gong bzhin bya/

yi dwags thams cad bza' btung gi 'byor pas tshim ste bkres skom phongs pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral nas mtho ris thar pa'i bde ba dam pa thob par gyur cig /ces smon lam gdab/ 'di zas ma zos gong kho nar bya'o// lnga pa byed na gzhi bdag gtor ma brgya rtsa'i skabs bzhin no// de nas brgya rtsa'i rim pa ni/ zan ril bcu tshan gyis rim par sbran te/ bsang sbyang byin rlabs cha bzhi'i skabs ltar sngon du 'gro bas/ dang po ni/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ zhes nyer gcig dang*/ arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la// 'bul lo bzhes nas bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gror// dbang skur byin rlobs mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ gnyis pa sambha ra dang arghaṃ sogs/ rnal 'byor dbang mo sgyu 'phrul mkha' 'gro lnga// mthu chen dam can bstan srung rgya mtsho la// 'bul lo bstan dang bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyongs// 'gal rkyen kun sol mthun rkyen char bzhin phob/ gsum pa sambha ra dang*/ arghaṃ sogs/ lha dang mi yi drang srong rig pa 'dzin// mngon shes lnga ldan bden tshig grub rnams la// 'bul lo rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar ba dang*// 'gro la phan bde'i smon lam gdab tu gsol/ bzhi pa sambha ra dang*/ arghaṃ sogs/ ngal gsos bu dang rmugs 'dzin gter gyi bdag /lhan skyes lha sogs dkar phyogs skyong kun la// 'bul lo nad gdon phongs rgud 'jigs bral nas// tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ lnga pa sambha ra bdun dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes mtshan bzhi brjod/

dzam gling spyi dang khyad par gangs can ljongs// bye brag yul 'di'i gzhi bdag 'khor bcas la// 'bul lo nad mug 'khrug rtsod kun zhi zhing*// rdzogs ldan 'byor pas 'gro kun 'tsho bar mdzod/ drug pa sambha ra dang mtshan bzhi/ 'brog gnas lnga sogs gnod sbyin sde dpon tshogs// 'phrog ma ma bu 'jig rten skyong rnams la// 'bul lo 'gro ba'i tshe srog gzi brjid mdangs// 'phrog sogs gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor zhi bar mdzod/ bdun pa sambha ra dang mtshan bzhi/ stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs dang gdon gyi rigs// nad yams dal bdag gnod byed tshogs rnams la// 'bul lo gdug pa'i bsam sbyor kun zhi zhing*// gzhan phan byang sems rgyud la skye gyur cig /brgyad pa sambha ra dang mtshan bzhi/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam lnga skye gnas bzhi// bar do'i 'gro ba tshe rabs drin can la// 'bul lo so so'i sdug bsngal kun bral nas// bla med byang chub mchog la spyod gyur cig /dgu pa sambha ra dang mtshan bzhi/ kha nas me 'bar phyi nang sgrib can sogs// bkres skoms kyis gdungs yi dwags tshogs kun la// bsngo'o zas skom char gyis rab tshim zhing*// ser sna'i sgrib bral thar pa'i bde thob shog /bcu pa sambha ra dang mtshan bzhi/ tshe rabs thog ma med nas da lta'i bar// srog lus longs spyod lan chags thams cad la// bsngo'i sha mkhon bu lon kun byang nas// phan bde'i dpal gyis rtag tu 'tsho bar shog /ces bsngo/ de nas lhag gtor bshams te/ sambha ra dang mtshan bzhi/ glo bur lhags dang khas nyen dbang chung ba// lhag ma bshal chu re ba kun la ster// so sor zas skom bdud rtsi'i dpal thob nas// zag med bde ba mchog la spyod par shog /ces dang*/ chos sbyin gong bzhin bya/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// 'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang*/

sems can rnams la phan gdags slad// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// thogs pa med par 'grub gyur cig /sogs bden pa'i stobs brjod de smon lam gdab bo// dam pa'i rten 'brel brgyad cu dang 'khyud spyad la brten pa'i 'byung bzhi'i gtor ma byed par spro na/ gtor snod lngar zan gyis zla gam/ gru gsum/ zlum po/ gru bzhi/ gtsang glud changs bu can rim pa bzhin bshams la/ rang nyid dam pa sangs rgyas sku mdog smug nag gcer bu mchog tu 'bar ba'i gzi byin can phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis ḍā ma ru dang dril bu 'khrol ba/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ros myos shing*/ 'khor 'das zil gyis gnon pa'i lta stangs mdzad par gyur/ oṃ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha na/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥ gtor ma rnams bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma'i ngo bo zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnam pa 'byung ba so so'i byed las dang mtshan nyid tshang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ de nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i sprin phung nam mkha' gang bar sad par bltas la/ arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ dang po ni/ yaṃ oṃ tsa tsha dza dzha nya yaṃ i ī/ lan gsum/ yaṃ las rlung rdzas sngon po g.yo ba 'di// shar phyogs rdo rje rigs kyi rtsa gsum lha// grangs med rab 'byams rgyal ba'i 'khor lor 'bul// rlung dang zhe sdang las gyur nad gdon zhi// chos kun rten 'brel rol par 'char ba dang*// don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i mchog stsol cig /gnyis pa/ raṃ oṃ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha na raṃ ṛ ṝ/ raṃ las me rdzas dmar po 'bar ba 'di// lho phyogs rin chen rigs kyi rtsa gsum lha// grangs med rab 'byams rgyal ba'i 'khor lor 'bul// me dang nga rgyal las gyur nad gdon zhi// chos kun rten 'brel rol par 'char ba dang*// don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i mchog stsol cig

/gsum pa/ waṃ oṃ pa pha ba bha ma waṃ u ū/ waṃ las chu rdzas dkar po brlan pa 'di// nub phyogs padma rigs kyi rtsa gsum lha// grangs med rab 'byams rgyal ba'i 'khor lor 'bul// chu dang 'dod chags las gyur nad gdon zhi// chos kun rten 'brel rol par 'char ba dang*// don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i mchog stsol cig /bzhi pa/ laṃ oṃ ta tha da dha na laṃ l̥ l̥̄/ laṃ las sa rdzas ser po mkhregs pa 'di// byang phyogs las kyi rigs kyi rtsa gsum lha// grangs med rab 'byams rgyal ba'i 'khor lor 'bul// sa dang phrag dog las gyur nad gdon zhi// chos kun rten 'brel rol par 'char ba dang*// don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i mchog stsol cig /lnga pa glud gtor bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las phung khams skye mched yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzugs glud mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba 'dod yon 'dzad pa med pa'i longs spyod kyi dkor nor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas par gyur par bltas la nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya dang*/ sambha ra dang mtshan bzhi brjod/ kye/ gnod byed gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs// tshur shog bden pa'i tshig la nyon// mdzes pa'i gzugs glud yid 'ong ldan// mkho rgu'i 'byor pa rgya mtshor bcas// ting 'dzin sngags rgyas rab sbar nas// lan chags sha 'khon gnyer ba dang*// gnod byed gdon bgegs yongs la bsngo// dgyes shing tshim par bzhes nas kyang*// mi dang glud gnyis brje ba dang*// gnod pa'i bsam sbyor zhi bar mdzod/ ces dang*/ chos sbyin gong bzhin byas la/ sarba bhu ta gatstsha/ zhes gshegs su gsol/ bar do'i 'gro ba rnams rjes su 'dzin pa'i slad du bar do cha bzhi ni/ gtor snod bzhir gnyis su lcog dang bcas pa dang*/ gnyis su zan brul rkyang pa bsham/ chu bran te brgya rtsa'i skabs ltar byin gyis brlab/ dang po gnyis la sambha ra nyer gcig dang*/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/

rtsa brgyud bla ma zhi khro rab 'byams lha// mchog gsum rgyal sras slob mar bcas la 'bul// bar do'i 'gro la dbang bskur byin rlob cing*// thugs rjes skyabs gnas dpung gnyen mdzad du gsol/ gnyis par/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs// bka' sdod pho nyar bcas pa rnams la 'bul// bar do'i 'gro rnams gshed ma'i bgegs bral zhing*// lam ston gnas spor sa mkhan mdzad du gsol/ phyi ma gnyis la sambha ra dang mtshan bzhi/ gsum par/ lhan skyes 'dre sogs bar do'i sems can la// gnod byed gshed ma'i bgegs rigs kun la bsngo// ngoms shing tshim nas phyin chad bar srid la// gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bsam sbyor zhi bar mdzod/ bzhi par/ shi nas lus rtain ma thob bar do'i 'gro// yid lus rten can mkha' mnyam kun la bsngo// 'khrul snang 'jigs skrag bar dor ngo shes shing*// dag pa'i zhing du skye ba len par shog /lnga pa bar do'i chu sbyin bya zhing chos kyi sbyin pa yang bya'o/ de nas mgron spyi la phrin las bcol ba ni/ oṃ/ bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtshor bcas// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mthu chen dang*// srid gsum 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyis sdong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi ba'i nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa yis// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/kyi bar dkyus bzhin bya/

bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// 'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang*// sems can kun la phan gdags slad// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// thogs pa med par 'grub gyur cig /sogs bden pa'i stobs brjod de smon lam gdab pa sngar bzhin dang*/ oṃ/ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzod// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ badzra muḥ gtor mgron mchog rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhags pa'i// 'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang*// gang yang sa steng 'khod pa dang*// sa blar rgyu ba gang yin pa// mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su// thams cad tha dad 'gro bar gyis/ sarba bhu ta gatstsha/ zhes dman pa rnams rang gnas su btang la bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas 'debs shing shis par brjod pa sogs rjes kyi bya bas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// legs par bshad pa'i ngag tshig mtho ris chab// srid pa sdig to'i khyab 'jug zhabs bsil du// sbreng ba'i nus gzugs dri bral byang chen gyi// rang gzugs tshogs gnyis lang tsho'i mdzes pa ngoms// lhag bsam sa 'dzin rtser son zla zer gyi// snang bas dge tshogs kunda'i myu gu dag /rgyas par byas dang lhan cig 'gro 'di yi// las nyon snying gi mun pa ci yang bsal// de lta'i legs byas tshogs gnyis gaṅgā'i rgyun// tshad med byang chub mchog gi mtshor zhugs te// kun mkhyen ye shes 'dod 'jo rin po che'i// 'byung gnas 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor gyur cig gu// mchod sbyin bsil gtor gyi cho ga gaṅgā'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba 'di ni bslab pa gsum gyi nor bus rgyud gtams shing spong ba'i brtul zhugs lhur byed pa'i dge slong tshul khrims mthar phyin gyis bskul ba las/
shākya'i dge bsnyen rig pa 'dzin pa 'gyur med rdo rjes bsam gtan gyi ri ngogs nges pa don gyi nags klung dam par sbyar ba 'gro kun byang chub mchog gi lam la dkri ba'i rgyur gyur cig// /
